segments.he: הָיוּ שְׁנֵיהֶם כֹּהֲנִים וְכוּ׳. תָּנוּ רַבָּנַן: הִכָּה זֶה וְחָזַר וְהִכָּה זֶה, קִלֵּל זֶה וְחָזַר וְקִלֵּל זֶה, קִלֵּל שְׁנֵיהֶם בְּבַת אַחַת, הִכָּה שְׁנֵיהֶם בְּבַת אַחַת — חַיָּיב. רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר: בְּבַת אַחַת — חַיָּיב, בָּזֶה אַחַר זֶה — פָּטוּר.
segments.en: § It is stated in the mishna that if «both» uncertain fathers «were priests,» the son is exempt from punishment for striking and for cursing them. «The Sages taught:» If «he struck this» uncertain father, «and then struck that one,» or if «he cursed this one and then cursed that one,» or if «he cursed both of them simultaneously» or «struck both of them simultaneously,» in all these cases «he is liable» to receive capital punishment, as one of them is certainly his father. «Rabbi Yehuda says:» Although if he struck or cursed both of them «simultaneously he is liable,» if he struck or cursed them «one after the other, he is exempt.»
